idea-plugin.name: Mobile Test Bench
idea-plugin.description:
Mirror and control Android and iOS devices in an IDE tool window, inspect their UI, and get ready-to-use locators for Mobilewright, Appium and WebdriverIO, without leaving your IDE.

Features

  • Mirror and control: Android emulators, Android phones, iOS simulators and iPhones. Click to tap, drag to swipe, hold for a long press, type with the keyboard.
  • Inspector: element tree, properties and a highlight on the screen. Every element gets locator suggestions with duplicate detection, scoped locators and an accessibility audit.
  • Recorder and player: record taps, swipes and text into a script, add assertions, replay it, and copy it as Mobilewright, Appium or WebdriverIO code.
  • Show Locator on Device: put the caret on a locator in your test code and highlight the elements it matches on the connected device (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M).
  • Device Tools: logs with filters and stack trace navigation, apps and permissions, crashes, location, display and language, network, battery, biometrics, web views, files, performance, visual diff and push notifications.
  • Device power and reconnect: boot, shut down or reboot devices, and reconnect automatically when a device drops.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ-based IDE 2025.3 or newer.
  • mobilecli (npm install -g mobilecli): needed for iOS, for the element inspector on Android 17, and for many Device Tools tabs.
  • adb from the Android SDK platform-tools for Android devices and emulators.
  • macOS with Xcode (simctl) for iOS simulators.
  • An iPhone needs a one-time install of the mobilecli agent with a development provisioning profile that includes the device.

Privacy

The plugin has no telemetry and sends no data off your machine. It talks to your devices through adb, xcrun and mobilecli, to the local emulator gRPC port, and to a WebDriverAgent URL you configure.

Source code, issues and support: github.com/marcomaes/MobileTestBench
